item.title: CERiSTREAMS 2 out + new website!
item.author: cering@cering.dev
item.description: CERiSTREAMS 2 is out now! the pack includes 25 new songs in the series with full difficulties, and 3 new original marathon-length mixes. also, the cering.dev website has gotten a design refresh, along with this fancy RSS feed! it's only about 60% of the way there at this point, so expect to see some smaller developments in the coming weeks!
